alterations.description: All references to the various sections of the Defence of India Act during the Khan Bahadur’s trial.
Reference to the names of Radha, Zarina and Kalpuns when they are introduced to Bismal by Azad as the new party members.

In the scene of looting of Seth’s house by Azad and his men, establish that they had come to collect donations for his party funds and not for burgling the Seth’s house. Delete shots in which one of Azad’s associates makes advances to Seth’s daughter, as also her dialogue referring to her being molested.
In the scene at Jhansi Fort, shots of Radha putting her arms around the police officer while pretending to seek his help.

All references to “Mamaji” (Azad’s uncle) relating to his attempt to betray Azad in order to secure the cash award for the arrest of Azad for purpose of marrying his daughter. Also reference to “Mama Bhanju” in the dialogue of the police officer rebuking the “Mamaji” for betraying him.
The suggestion that Sethji gets killed during the firing while approaching Azad to warn him.
Shot of Sethji informing police of Azad’s whereabouts in Allahabad.
The scene of flogging of Azad in the jail.

Insert a tablet at the beginning stating that for purposes of dramatisation, some imaginary incidents and characters have been incorporated in the film, but due care has been taken to present the heroic struggle and personality of the famous revolutionary Chandrashekhar Azad.

alterations.description: Suitably modify the scenes and dialogues of Arjun and his wife, close associates of Azad, so as to establish that they were neither cowardly or cowardly persons.
In the Kakori train looting scene establish that Azad did not intend to harm innocent passengers but only to get possession of the government treasury.
Establish in the dialogue of the Police Superintendent Scott, that Lala Lajpatrai was beaten by the Police and not by any individual police officer.
